description: Create or edit one EDI item mapping: which Spark item a trading partner's SKU or UPC stands for, with the customer's description and unit, the conversion to the Spark unit and the customer price. Omit id to create (tradingPartnerId, itemId and a customerSku or customerUpc required; get ids from list_edi_trading_partners and list_items); pass id to edit, where every omitted field keeps its value. A customer SKU or UPC maps to one item per partner. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

id.description: The item mapping id (GUID) to edit; omit to create.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

customerDescription.description: The customer's description of the item.

customerPrice.description: The customer's agreed price per customer unit, zero or more.

customerSku.description: The customer's SKU for the item, unique per partner. A mapping needs this or the UPC.

customerUom.description: The unit the customer orders in (e.g. CA).

customerUpc.description: The customer's UPC for the item, unique per partner.

itemId.description: Spark item id (GUID) the customer's SKU stands for. Required when creating.

sparkUom.description: The Spark unit it converts to (e.g. EA).

tradingPartnerId.description: Trading partner id (GUID). Required when creating.

uomConversionFactor.description: Spark units per customer unit, greater than zero (e.g. 12 when a case holds 12 each). A new mapping uses 1.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: save_edi_item_mapping
title: Save EDI Item Mapping
